newsitem.title: USA: Equitable Resources buys Costilla pipeline.
newsitem.headline: Equitable Resources buys Costilla pipeline.

text.p: Equitable Resources Inc said effective January 1, it has purchased Costilla Pipeline Corp, owners of the Three Rivers Pipeline, from Costilla Energy of Midland, Texas.

The Three Rivers Pipeline is a 120-mile, 8-inch natural gas intrastate pipeline which runs from an interconnection with National Fuel Gas Co near Midland, Penn. east to an interconnection with People's Natural Gas near Altoona, Penn. Terms of the deal were not disclosed.
"This pipeline can provide an array of alternative delivery service options to existing and new customers," John Gongas, senior vice president of Equitable, said.
